requirements.1_METHOD_SELECTION_REANALYSIS: Metrics, pre-calculation sensitivity grid, paired Qwen/Gemma contrasts, verdict, strongest claim and overclaim present
requirements.2_METHOD_SELECTION_TABLE: 24 model/condition-or-group rows; all executed update seeds plus recipe/class means and labeled controls; rates and 95% uncertainty; original group SHS intervals
requirements.3_EQUIVALENCE_ANALYSIS: 360 metric/comparison/margin rows; 95% and 99% paired CIs, margins, equivalence decisions and SHS difference; 40 conjunction decisions; seed and common-support supplements
requirements.4_POINTWISE_VS_RELATIONAL_ARGUMENT: Two formal paragraphs, caveat, plain-English version, one-sentence standard-evaluation answer, bounded empirical connection
requirements.5_PAPER_READY_PARAGRAPH: Conditional A explicitly unsupported and non-publishable as current result; evidence-supported fallback B
requirements.constraints: No inference/GPU/provider run; frozen inputs/code verified unchanged before and after; no model settings changed; no subagents

limitations: Retrospective new analysis; original public SHS rates were already known
Synthetic bounded locality/generalization, not a complete external editing benchmark
Percentile bootstrap uncertainty over generated roots, not deployment prevalence
Source archive is not a Git checkout; local hash-bound Python replay used, no rr execution receipt fabricated
